mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and lower equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL level over the 20-day horizon remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 4.0 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.7% and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.1756 indicates an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 3.7 and INDPRO < 109.1756 are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in instances where HOUST < 1200 are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 109.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where INDPRO < 109.0 are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer confidence and a robust housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS level over the 60-day horizon remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strong manufacturing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO level over the 20-day horizon remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
